summary: TruGolf Holdings filed an 8-K reporting consummation on October 8, 2026 of its previously announced August 17, 2026 acquisition of Polymath Research Inc., a Canadian corporation, via a Canadian amalgamation with TruGolf's wholly owned SubCo; Amalco is now a wholly owned subsidiary. Polymath options were assumed and converted into TruGolf Class A options on the same vesting terms, with share counts and exercise prices adjusted by an exchange ratio. TruGolf must file a proxy seeking stockholder approval to convert Series B preferred issued in the concurrent financing, increase equity plan shares, and related charter amendments, and must reserve $2.5M of working capital; watch preferred conversion dilution and integration funding.
